title: V-Bar Pull Up
instructions: Place the V-Bar over the top of the pull up bar and grip the bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Let your body hang straight down with your arms extended. This is the starting position.
Engage your back and arms to pull your chest up towards the bar as close as possible. Keep your elbows close to your body.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms. This is one rep.
Do the desired number of reps with smooth and controlled movements.
tips: Use a full range of motion on every rep.
Avoid using momentum by swinging to pull your body up.
Control your body throughout the movement.
Weight can be added for extra intensity.
